
# Harmoni Hanjawong Village

> Harmoni Hanjawong Village adalah proyek pengembangan kawasan kavling tanah ke-14 dari PT Harmoni Grup Indonesia, berlokasi di Desa Sukamakmur, Kecamatan Sukamakmur, Kabupaten Bogor, Jawa Barat.

## Official Website

- Website: https://harmonihanjawongvillage.co.id/
- Brand: Harmoni Hanjawong Village
- Developer: PT Harmoni Grup Indonesia
- Location: Sukamakmur, Bogor, Jawa Barat, Indonesia
- Postal Code: 16831
- Concept: Property, Nature, Leisure & Lifestyle

## About the Project

Harmoni Hanjawong Village merupakan kawasan pengembangan kavling tanah SHM yang mengangkat potensi alam Sukamakmur dan panorama Gunung Hanjawong.

Kawasan ini menggabungkan karakter alam, akses wisata, area komersial, dan rencana fasilitas pendukung.

## Legal Information

- Land ownership: Sertifikat Hak Milik (SHM)
- Spatial designation: Zona Kuning / PP2
- Location: Desa Sukamakmur, Kecamatan Sukamakmur, Kabupaten Bogor.

## Land Products

### Hanjawong Aruna
- Concept: Sunrise Living
- Reference Price: Rp1.299.000/m²

### Hanjawong Terra
- Concept: Green Productive
- Reference Price: Rp1.099.000/m²

### Hanjawong Reserve
- Concept: Premium View
- Reference Price: Rp899.000/m²

Prices are reference prices and may change.
Confirm current prices and availability with the official marketing team.

## Facilities

- Resto kawasan
- Flying Fox
- Children's Playground
- Mushola and Toilet
- Asphalt Road
- Electricity Infrastructure
- U-Ditch Drainage
- Solar Cell

These facilities include planned development components.
